details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`: this is the first failure of the test file in 15 comparable runs. It passed in N22 at [`913e91ed`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/913e91ed51fd15c757b975024d8a55e076eba74d) and fails in N23 at `16aa8160`. The scheduler raised at `deepseek_v4_backend.py:3398` (`q_lora = q_lora[:n]`).

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[HIGH]`: [#45407](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45407) ([`26396bf5`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/26396bf56696b8edc53d955cdf232fdfc167611a)) made `forward_low_ratio_sources` slice `q_lora[:n]` on every step.
On gfx950, `q_lora` is an `Mxfp8Activation` struct, which cannot be sliced.
The commit is in the `913e91ed..16aa8160` window (verified with the compare API).

details.label: Disconfirming
details.text: [#45980](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45980) is in the same window and moved where the fused MXFP8 producers run `[LOW]`. A new HF snapshot of the model is also possible `[LOW]`.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ✅ [#46151](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46151) (open since 2026-10-23 18:56 UTC). It restores the `n < positions.shape[0]` guard and slices quantized activations row-wise. Chase reviewers; do not open a duplicate.

details.label: Suggested triage
details.text: run `test_deepseek_v41_flash_eval_mi35x.py` on MI35x with #46151 applied.

clusters.title: MI355X disagg: GPUs occupied before server start ("memory capacity is unbalanced" / OOM at load) — day 2, 3 legs in D3

details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`:
Prefill on `pit2-p03-g11` hit OOM with `0 bytes free` of 287.98 GiB, about 7.8 GiB of it allocated by PyTorch.
Decode on `pit2-p03-g02` raised `_check_tp_memory_balance` (`pre_model_load_memory=22.98`).
This happened between 07:12 and 07:39 UTC. The other 34 D3 legs passed.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[HIGH]` per job: the node environment held the memory, not sglang. `[SPECULATION]` it is held by orphaned processes from earlier jobs or by another tenant in the 07:00–08:30 window. **Disconfirming**: the holder has not been identified; the launcher runs no VRAM or PID check.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ❌ none found. Searched `memory+capacity+unbalanced` and `launch_mi355x`.

details.label: Suggested triage
details.text: run `rocm-smi --showpids` on g11 and g02 around 07:00 UTC. Add a VRAM-free pre-check to `scripts/ci/slurm/launch_mi355x.sh`.
